data.content_ref: inline:SRC_007 contradicts SRC_006 because the append-only monotonicity assumption fails when committed artifacts can be legitimately revoked and re-admitted, abstracting the universal invariant 'every committed artifact satisfies P' to a model-independent specification of correctness that is not bound by monotonic growth; it is refuted if the committed artifact set is provably append-only in the target repository, making monotonicity the stronger and more appropriate property and rendering the revocation-driven abstraction unnecessary.
